title: The Only Way, the Open Way
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: The gospel is exclusive in that only Jesus saves, and the least exclusive message in the world in that anyone may come. Our job is to show people the way out.
exhortation: Yesterday I had the opportunity to share the gospel with someone. I was walking through a store, struck up a conversation, and invited him to church. (First thought: why don't I do this all the time?) He got stuck on one question: "Are you guys exclusive? Like, Jesus is the only way?" I said, "Yes, we're exclusive in that way."

It was a great opening for the gospel. In one sense we are very exclusive: only Jesus saves. But in another sense this is the least exclusive message there is. No one is excluded from the gospel because of anything they are or anything they've done: black, white, British, American, Mexican, Chinese. Whoever repents and turns to Jesus will be saved. There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free. "For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life."

What bothered him was that some Christians he'd known seemed to be pounding their chests, as if they were the ones who got it right. I told him there is no room for pride in Christianity. Jesus didn't save me because I'm special or better. The only thing I brought to the table was needing to be saved.

No analogy is perfect, but imagine a burning building. If someone said, "I've found the only way out," no one would argue, "That sounds pretty exclusive." It would only be unfair if he said, "I've found the way out, and I'm only going to show you." We know the way out, not because we figured it out, but because someone saved us and told us. Our job is to proclaim it. The harvest is plentiful and the laborers are few. We don't need to hesitate or wonder whether the person in front of us is worthy. We don't save. We proclaim the truth: the building is on fire, follow me. What a wonderful gospel we get to proclaim: the one way out, open to all, Jesus Christ our Lord.
prayer: Lord, protect us and keep us from ever straying from the one way, the only gospel of Jesus Christ. Guard us from drifting and from embracing any other doctrine or way but the truth of your word and of who you are, Jesus: the way, the truth and the life.

And may we open our arms wide to all. Give us eyes to see the lost and dying all around us who need a way out of a fire they don't even know is there. Give us hearts of deep compassion that break for a lost world running headlong toward hell unless they are told the way. Help us be faithful stewards of the gospel. In Jesus' name, amen.
